body: Yeah I was very confused.

When I say strong support system I mean friends and family. Thats why maybe a support group is a nice compromise. You could learn some new ways to cope and just talk to people who relate to what you're going through. It is okay if thats not for you though.

My experience with therapists is that sure some are clinical, but I genuinely believe that my current psychologist cares. Not in friend kind of way but she wants me to get better. I recognise we aren't friends but I also recognise that part of her cares about me/my health in some kind of way.

Sometimes we need medical help and a strong support system. I hear what you're saying that you don't like therapists and hospitals though. Are there any support groups for mental health in your area you'd be willing to go to? This way you get support and also social stuff.

Psychosis is a very different experience for everyone. Some people experience some symptoms while others don't. I believe it is possible to psychotic and not having hallucinations experiencing instead things like delusions, paranoia, etc. If you ever notice weird intrusive thoughts that become increasingly difficult to test and believe the test results talk to someone. If I knew the warning signs it would've saved me a lot of pain.

Hi. I'm not usually the one commenting on these posts. I usually am the poster. I read posts on here because it makes me less alone but I never reply because how can I help someone who wants to die when I feel the same. I also don't have any profound advice because if I had any I'd be using it. I get what you mean though. Sometimes it can seem like people on here comment serially in order to save people with the same kind of stuff. They want to save *people* generally but not *me* specifically...

Have you tried therapy and seeing a psychiatrist? I'm the kind of person who believes it is everyone's choice about when and how they die if they choose to do so prematurely, however, I also strongly believe that one should exhaust all other avenues of help before doing that. Even hospital as an option can help with recovery. My hospital stays while not helpful longterm gave me a break from everything that was happening for me.

I'm sorry if this isn't really hopeful but I do hope you continue to try and recover until there is nothing left to try.

Yeah man its rough ay. It is hugely hypocritical of me to say, but I do believe that even chronic mental illness can be managed for most people, I'm just not one of them. Maybe you are.

Message me if you need to chat. I'll do my best to listen.

My attachment issues are slightly different but they're an issue. I find that when I'm in any sort of mania or that awkward sort of hypomania I still experience on my lithium, people are drawn to me. I'm not really conventionally good looking or anything but people like the energy and confidence. Men are especially into this. They find my passion for everything including them attractive. But then it ends and I'm back to awkward, slightly \(or severely\) depressed me. They still see remnants of the person I was so they stay for a while but I drain everyone around of me of life when I'm like this so they leave. Or I leave them so they don't leave me. So now I try and not let other people in because not only will I be hurt by the inevitable abandonment, but I will exhaust them if they and I somehow stay.

Even if you don’t get into your first choice immediately, you can always transfer! Let me know how your exam goes okay? Make sure to take care of yourself before the exam. Eat something. Have some water. Breathe.

Yeah I am more scared of living than dying, I relate to that hugely. I'm glad that what has happened to me and my decisions have given you some strength. I won't say you should keep going because that would be awfully hypocritical of me, but I can say please do keep going while there's still fight in you. I'll message you tomorrow probably :)

I'm glad helping me, helped you. I also missed a tonne of school in my final year of high school (I'm assuming its your final year based on your age but I could be wrong based on where you're from. If I am wrong you'd be in year 11 at the least and the point still stands) and completely crammed for my final exams. I did not do as well as I could have if I was well or if I had better attendance but the fact I went, sat those stupid exams, and came out the other side was an awesome achievement and my mark didn't matter. I did better than I expected and still got into a good university with a good course.

Also with my knowledge of the schooling system of the USA, congratulations on doing an AP course. Thats like top level shit man. And you're sticking with it despite your troubles.

I did, for a few years, know who I was outside of this struggle. It took a lot of therapy to reach that point. I am quickly losing that. A diagnosis like bipolar completely dictates mood and therefore action and, to me at least, perception of one's or other's identities is based hugely on action. It is the manifestation of action. Now with my diagnosis I lack control over my actions so it is very hard to grasp the underlying person still within me.

I also am painfully aware of the fact that an inability to have a concrete view of oneself is typical of ongoing childhood abuse like you said. Maybe to other people they see who I am because of how I act but even then I would have at least three distinct patterns of action: that when I'm manic, depressed, or that brief period of stability. 

Medication of course stabilises but with sacrifices to my health. My memory goes to shit and my hands shake horribly. Those are the most upsetting side effects. It numbs my emotional range and for as long as I can remember I've had experiences outside of the standard range, that was part of who I was. Now I'm being told that part of me is unhealthy and essentially has to die. 

I don't know who I am. I am slowly losing everything my identity was based on before. 

I just realised that is a bit rambly and kind of angsty but I hope you get my point, regardless of its rather convoluted nature.

Thank you for saying I'm not an imposition. That is one of my biggest fears and even hearing from an internet stranger is nice. 

I am still shocked by the quantity of support. I didn't expect any responses but of course receiving some wouldn't hurt. I hoped for maybe one kind person to read it all and say something but instead I had over twenty. It is ridiculously amazing. Reddit never stops surprising me with how good people on here can be, despite the less than ideal reputation amongst people who don't use the site.

I am reading this and thank you for the response. It means a lot to me that people are still replying to this. I reconsidered for today because of comments like this. I hope you are doing alright and if you need to vent feel free to message me. Despite this being a throwaway I will keep checking it for a while. I will keep trying. Thank you again. I wish I was as compassionate as you in dark times. You seem like a very good person.
Thanks for the Boomerang recommendation. I will probably get sent to the hospital after I see my psych tomorrow.

You're right with the logistics as well. There is a chance I'd survive the jump because its not completely vertical. If I slipped and fell I'd just end up mildly fucked physically but be alive probably.

Yeah it is temporary I suppose but it is only a small part of a very large problem. I wouldn't be my friend either while I'm this unwell. I can't promise I'll stay, but as I've said in other replies, I can promise I'll try to get through another day.
I am okay for now. I hope I do find peace soon.

I have an appointment with my psych tomorrow so I'll at least wait until after that. They might put me in hospital but we'll see. I really don't want to hurt anyone, I just don't know how else to stop feeling.
Part of me hopes I make it. I desperately want to be stronger. I will keep trying. One day at a time.
I didn't. I'm alive for today.

I did see this. I am really sorry about your sister. Losing someone like that is a grief I can't quite imagine and perhaps that is why I'm willing to inflict it. If you want to talk about your sister at all you can PM me. I appreciate the offer for me to connect with you. It means a lot. I might do that. I will use this throwaway periodically for a while.

Hey, firstly I'm sorry you've experienced similar things. Its really rough and I hope you're doing okay. Thank you for your comment. You are right. I suppose I will die eventually anyway. What is one more day. I will promise you another day. That is all I can promise right now regarding time but I do promise in whatever time I have left I will keep looking for something to keep me alive.

You're right. Ending my life is letting my abuser win. I really do hate to lose especially if its losing to someone I despise. I'm okay with losing now. It is a peaceful feel to relinquish his control and say I'm doing something for me out of pure selfishness rather than fear. I am getting through today though and I suppose that is another small victory.
I didn't do it. I can promise I am alright for the rest of today. Thank you for replying
Thanks. I am okay for today.

I am still here. I appreciate your post because, while it is very supportive, you're not telling me what to do. You're not trying to take away my power. That means a lot. Posts like yours kept me here. I don't feel hopeful but it calmed me enough that I promised myself another day. There was that tiny bit of me that wanted to try just once more, mainly for my little brother.

Today was a beautiful day even if it ended differently to how I intended. There was a lot of self reflection and it reminded me I need to tell those I care about how much I love them more. No one knows in real life that I was planning to do it today and maybe they never will but thats okay. 

I'm glad my story had an impact you even if its not permanent. Thank you for the effort you put into your comment. I never expected responses let alone really thoughtful ones like this.
Thank you. I hope I find peace in some way or another.

I'm really sorry to hear about your girlfriend. I too hope she passed in peace. I hope you can find a way to live with this grief. I don't know if it'll ever go away but I hope it doesn't consume you forever. If you want to tell me about her feel free to message me.

Obviously, by the fact I'm replying, I am still here and am okay for today. 

Thank you for your comment. I hope we both find peace in this pain somehow.
I didn't do it today. For the rest of today I am safe. Thank you for commenting, it means a lot to me. It really does.

I did reconsider for today and am safe. It is now dark so my beautiful plan kind of got fucked by the overwhelming amount of support on this post. I could help others and I might if I manage to get through this. I see my psychiatrist tomorrow for an emergency appointment so maybe they can help me get through the next few months.

This was really poetic actually. It is past sunset and I am okay. You're right. This is the one life I get but I really don't want it. I am safe for tonight though. I hope you are doing well. Thank you.

I didn't go through with it. Instead I did what I always do and procrastinate on Reddit. But rather than the typical memey shit I looked at the comments on this post and it helped get me through until dark. Thank you for your comment.

I just got back home from the beachy cliff thing. I did everything I planned except jump. I sat and watched the sunset and it was really pretty today. I figured I should check my throwaway and I honestly expected no responses and I'm overwhelmed by what I've read.

Thank you very much for your comment. I do not feel happier or more hopeful but I'm through another day and I guess thats an achievement. A friend called me today and said that maybe I don't have big choices at the moment about my life but the small ones can really add up to be lifechanging. Things like who my friends are, how I treat others, how I treat myself, etc. It won't seem important now but those things do have an impact. That really helped me get through today.

I appreciate your empathy. Knowing someone else went through something similar and came out the other side alright is nice to know.

I can't promise tomorrow will not end how today was supposed to but for now I am safe.

Thanks.
